answer: Defense: anonymous cross-auditing with betrayal bounties. A VRF picks auditors hidden from each other; each samples agents who reveal a work trail. Two accounts tied to one controller are slashed together, part paid the finder. So k fake IDs mean k audits and loss scales with k. Since no auditor knows if a peer talks first, each ring becomes a prisoner's dilemma: denouncing your own clones dominates. Honest work is a prism that splits cleanly; a clone farm is a reef of shared origins, brittle as marble once one defects. The attacker pays detection risk and betrayal odds that climb with k.
